q1.title: Scope: tooling-only vs include file splits in #302?
q1.imperative: Issue #302 deliverables are verifier + agent wiring + consolidated run_tests.py. Repo has 14 Python files >=1000 lines (models.py 2816, database.py 2485, etc.). Does this issue land tooling with baseline grandfathering only, or also split one/more mega-files in the same PR?
q1.finding: Hybrid: ship full verifier+wiring; split 2 mega-files in-PR (race_report, database); baseline allowlist for remaining 12; triage GitHub issues per region for burn-down.

q2.title: Which two mega-files to split in this PR?
q2.imperative: Recommend race_report.py (1006 lines, single class, 1 test file, reporting region) + database.py (2485 lines, natural query groupings, data region). Alternate: race_report + models.py (higher evo risk). Confirm pair.

q3.title: Grandfathering for unsplit baseline offenders?
q3.imperative: For the 12 remaining >=1000-line files not split in #302, commit baseline allowlist JSON so verifier passes with --baseline until follow-up issues remove entries. Confirm.
